The '''1956–57 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by two points over nearest rival [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]]. [[Dunfermline Athletic F.C.|Dunfermline Athletic]] and [[Ayr United F.C.|Ayr United]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1957–58 Scottish Division Two]].
